instruction:
You write tests/processor/registry.examples.test.ts only. Import readRegistry, PREFIX, KEYS and DEFAULT_BASE_URL from "../../src/processor/registry.js", types from "../../src/processor/types.js", and fixtureJson from "../helpers.js". Every call passes a literal env object as the record's example gives it (never process.env). Example 1 compares the one config with toStrictEqual against fixtureJson("processor/glmConfig.json"). Faults are compared in order, key and message, exactly as the record spells them (example 3 has four, example 4 four). One test(...) per example below, in this order, named `<Function> example <n>: <what>`; then at most twelve tests of your own on section 2.2. Compare answers, usage and configs with toStrictEqual, strings and numbers with toBe. Write no file outside a tmpRoot(); no setTimeout, no vi.mock, no vi.stubGlobal, no vi.useFakeTimers, no function or variable named fetch or Fake*. Import only the names you use: eslint rejects an unused import or type.

The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), and each test's docstring names the Function and the example number, e.g. `Read Registry example 1`.

Examples of Function Read Registry:
1. given env {PATH: "/usr/bin:/bin", MORPH_PROCESSOR_glm53_TYPE: "openrouter", MORPH_PROCESSOR_glm53_MODEL: "z-ai/glm-5.3", MORPH_PROCESSOR_glm53_API_KEY: "sk-or-test", MORPH_PROCESSOR_glm53_CONCURRENCY: "4", MORPH_PROCESSOR_glm53_PROVIDER_ORDER: "Novita, Together", MORPH_PROCESSOR_glm53_REASONING_MAX_TOKENS: "2500"}; when read; then faults []; configs exactly [the config of the fixture]: id glm53, route sync, concurrency 4, providerOrder ["Novita", "Together"], reasoning {maxTokens: 2500}, timeoutMs 600000, maxRetries 2, answersDir null (ref: tests/fixtures/processor/glmConfig.json (the one config))
2. given env {MORPH_PROCESSOR_stub_TYPE: "stub", MORPH_PROCESSOR_stub_ANSWERS_DIR: " /tmp/answers "}; when read; then faults []; one config {id: "stub", type: "stub", model: "stub", apiKey: null, baseUrl: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", route: "sync", concurrency: 1, providerOrder: null, reasoning: null, timeoutMs: 600000, maxRetries: 2, answersDir: "/tmp/answers"}
3. given env {MORPH_PROCESSOR_a_TYPE: "openrouter", MORPH_PROCESSOR_b_TYPE: "stub", MORPH_PROCESSOR_b_ANSWERS_DIR: "/x", MORPH_PROCESSOR_b_CONCURRENCY: "0", MORPH_PROCESSOR_c_TYPE: "openai", MORPH_PROCESSOR_d_TYPE: "stub", MORPH_PROCESSOR_d_ANSWERS_DIR: "/x"}; when read; then configs: only d; faults exactly four, in this order: MORPH_PROCESSOR_a_API_KEY "MORPH_PROCESSOR_a_API_KEY is required", MORPH_PROCESSOR_a_MODEL "MORPH_PROCESSOR_a_MODEL is required", MORPH_PROCESSOR_b_CONCURRENCY "MORPH_PROCESSOR_b_CONCURRENCY must be a positive integer (got '0')", MORPH_PROCESSOR_c_TYPE "MORPH_PROCESSOR_c_TYPE must be one of openrouter, stub (got 'openai')"
4. given env {MORPH_PROCESSOR_e_TYPE: "stub", MORPH_PROCESSOR_e_ANSWERS_DIR: "/x", MORPH_PROCESSOR_e_REASONING_EFFORT: "low", MORPH_PROCESSOR_e_REASONING_MAX_TOKENS: "100", MORPH_PROCESSOR_e_FOO: "1", MORPH_PROCESSOR_x_y_TYPE: "stub"}; when read; then configs []; faults exactly four, in this order: "MORPH_PROCESSOR_e_FOO is not a known key", "MORPH_PROCESSOR_e_REASONING_EFFORT conflicts with MORPH_PROCESSOR_e_REASONING_MAX_TOKENS: set one", "MORPH_PROCESSOR_x_TYPE is required", "MORPH_PROCESSOR_x_y_TYPE is not a known key" (the id is x, its key y_TYPE)
